provenance: Goose port of the outer __global__ flash_attn_ext_f16 (fattn-mma-f16.cuh L1796-2003); the exact native outer function was read and mirrored line by line, not guessed. Fixed Apex Ada instantiation DKQ=DV=256, ncols2=8, ncols1 in {4,8}, nthreads=128, stream_k=true (fixed by call site L2105). All process_tile numerics are owned by the separately ported Goose process module (inputs/process-draft.goose); this entry declares one extern adapter to that actual Goose module and performs no original C++ math callback. Native config tables L38-266 resolve per architecture at compile time; only the Ampere rows (256,256,32) and (256,256,64) match the fixed config (nthreads=128, occupancy=2, nbatch_fa=32, nbatch_K2=nbatch_V2=nbatch_combine=128, nstages_target=2, Q_in_reg=true). No runtime acceptance is claimed; the parent owns the CUDA bridge, raw-primitive bindings, codegen, real GPU parity gates and rollback.

fixed_config.np: nwarps*cols_per_warp/ncols = (4*16)/(ncols1*8): 2 when ncols1==4, else 1 (native L609/L1229 active branch)
fixed_config.hardware: CUDA Ada (AMPERE_MMA_AVAILABLE + CP_ASYNC_AVAILABLE path); all other architectures/configs deferred

entry.call_convention: Parent CUDA wrapper calls it once per block thread of a (32,4,1) block (warp_size=32 x nwarps=4, native nthreads=128). gridDim.x comes from the host stream-K policy (stream_k=true at L2105, blocks_num=(x,1,1), launch_fattn L1168-1186); blockIdx.y/z are unused. Native c1/c2 grid/tile policy is host-provided via ncols1 and gx; the entry contains no forced fallback and no grid heuristic. PDL launch attributes (programmatic stream serialization) are parent-owned; the entry performs only the device-side griddepcontrol wait as its first statement, exactly native L1820. No host launch policy, no CUDA runtime API, no VM heap and no local-address intrinsic inside the entry; the only raw effects are pdl_sync and one int32 KV_max word load.

raw_effects.isa: griddepcontrol.wait (cudaGridDependencySynchronize); mirrors ggml_cuda_pdl_sync() placed as the first kernel statement at native L1820; this kernel contains no ggml_cuda_pdl_lc() call; must compile to a no-op on pre-sm90 targets exactly like the native macro
raw_effects.binding: new member of the fg175p primitive family shared with the process module; the vec sibling experiment used a module-scoped fg175v_sync, so the parent binds the actual symbol once for this family

raw_effects.isa: generic/global u32 word load at p+4*i; used ONLY for the dense KV_max int32 reads (element index sequence*iter_j+jt, little-endian int32 reinterpreted from u32); same symbol family already declared by inputs/process-contract.json

extern_process_tile.implementation: the actual Goose process module (inputs/process-draft.goose, function process_tile); NOT the original C++ flash_attn_ext_f16_process_tile and no C++ math callback
extern_process_tile.match_status: VERBATIM MATCH with inputs/process-draft.goose L79: parameter names, order, types and count (34) are identical; no mismatch for the parent to adapt. If the built process artifact registers a different link symbol than the draft's self-declared fg175m_process_tile (draft header line 1), the parent adapts only the extern string in device.goose (single point, no signature change).
extern_process_tile.argument_mapping: q_f2/k_h2/v_h2/mask_h/dstk are derived here exactly as native L1919-1925; dstk_fixup is the raw dst_meta_p base; scale forwarded; slope is the constant 1.0f (native L1929 takes the ncols2==1 ? get_alibi_slope(...) : 1.0f else-branch at compile time for ncols2=8); ne01z=(i64)ne01_z; logit_softcap is not a process parameter because the process module is the softcap-free fixed specialization (native receives it but the active specialization ignores it)

outer_entry_owns: all per-tile pointer bases and stride derivation (L1883-1888, L1919-1926)
boundary_ownership.process_module_owns: everything listed in inputs/process-contract.json (Q staging, Q_B ldmatrix, initial cp.async preloads, kb0 loop, softmax, sinks, meta combine, VKQ staging, output/fixup); the entry never touches shared memory, the POD bytes, or any floating-point value

outer_control_facts: pdl_sync() is the first statement (L1820); parent owns the PDL launch attributes; on pre-sm90 the native macro compiles empty so the primitive may be a no-op there.
gqa_ratio=ne02/ne12 (L1881).
Strides: stride_Q1=nb01/8, stride_Q2=nb02/8, stride_K=nb11/4, stride_mask=nb31/2, stride_V=nb21/4 (V_is_K_view=false) (L1883-1888); all i32 divisions then widened to i64 for the process signature.
iter_k=ceil(ne11/32), iter_j=ceil(ne01_z/ncols1), iter_z_gqa=ceil(gqa_ratio/8) (L1890-1892) with explicit divisors replacing fastdiv.
use_sparse=false: the L1894-1896 KV_max rebase and the sparse_indices pointer (L1828, L1927) are absent.

Stream-K partition: total=iter_k*iter_j*iter_z_gqa*ne12*ne03 computed in i32 with the native left-associative operand order (wrap preserved); kbc=(int)((i64)bx*total/gx); kbc_stop=(int)((i64)(bx+1)*total/gx); the i64 mul/div then int truncation of L1899-1900 is preserved.
kb0_start=kbc%iter_k; kb0_stop=min(iter_k, kb0_start+kbc_stop-kbc) with native left-associative summation (L1907-1908).
Uniform-tile loop: while kbc<kbc_stop && kb0_stop==iter_k (L1910).

Decode (L1912-1915): sequence=kbc/(iter_k*iter_j*iter_z_gqa*ne12); z_KV=(kbc-...*sequence)/(iter_k*iter_j*iter_z_gqa); zt_gqa=(kbc-...-...*z_KV)/(iter_k*iter_j); jt=(kbc-...-...*zt_gqa)/iter_k; identical integer results with explicit divisors.
zt_Q=z_KV*gqa_ratio+zt_gqa*ncols2 (L1917).

Q base uses native i32 offset arithmetic nb03*sequence+nb02*zt_Q sign-extended on pointer add (L1919); K base uses i64 nb13 (L1920); V base uses i64 nb23 (L1925, V_is_K_view=false so V is never the K view).
mask_h=mask+nb33*(sequence%ne33) formed unconditionally; the ncols2==1&&!mask nullptr ternary is compile-time absent for ncols2=8 (L1921-1922).
dstk=dst+8*((sequence*ne01_z*ne02+zt_Q)*128) bytes (L1923, DV/2=128 float2 elements).
sinks_f = sinks_p!=0 ? sinks_p+4*zt_Q : 0 (L1926).
slope=1.0f constant: the get_alibi_slope call lives in the ncols2==1 branch (L1929); max_bias/m0/m1/n_head_log2 remain entry params (param map preserved) but are unused.

Dense KV_max clamp (L1933-1935 else-if): kb0_stop=min(kb0_stop, (int)KV_max[sequence*iter_j+jt]/32) with native signed i32 division; int32 little-endian load via fg175p_ldu32; index layout matches the flash_attn_mask_to_KV_max writer KV_max[sequence*ne31+jt] with ne31==ntiles_x==iter_j (fattn-common.cuh L723/L1122-1131).

Fixup flags: loop iterations carry is_fixup=false and needs_fixup=(kb0_start!=0) (L1936-1947); the final partial tile carries is_fixup=true and needs_fixup=false (L1986-1990); these are the exact native unaligned/uniform boundary flags.
Loop advance: kbc+=iter_k; kbc-=kbc%iter_k; kb0_start=0; kb0_stop=min(iter_k, kbc_stop-kbc) (L1949-1953).

Final tile guard: native 'if (kbc>=kbc_stop) return;' (L1956-1958) is mirrored as 'if kbc<kbc_stop { ... }' around the only following statement, which is control-flow identical (no top-level return construct is used).

np=(nwarps*cols_per_warp)/ncols=(4*16)/(ncols1*8): 2 for ncols1=4, 1 for ncols1=8 (L609/L1229 active branch); ncols1 in {4,8} is a caller requirement; the static_assert nwarps*(cols_per_warp/ncols2)%ncols1==0 (L1242) holds for both (8%4==0, 8%8==0).

stream_k=true is fixed at the call site (L2105): the grid is 1-D (blocks_num=(x,1,1), launch_fattn L1168-1186), blockIdx.y/z unused, dst_meta is the stream-K fixup buffer; the non-stream-K parallel-blocks branch of launch_fattn (L1191-1224) is dead for this kernel.

async_kv_preload = nstages==2 && !use_sparse = true for this config (L2103); it only affects parent launch attributes; the 2-stage preload protocol itself is implemented inside the process/iterate modules per the process contract.

compile_time_guards_vacuous_for_this_ins: L1834 use_logit_softcap && !(DKQ==128||256||512): use_logit_softcap=false (instantiation selected iff logit_softcap==0.0f, L2055-2056); parent must bind this entry only when logit_softcap==0.0f.
L1847-1873 Volta/Turing/AMD ncols guards: architecture-compile-time; the Ada build takes the AMPERE_MMA_AVAILABLE path where none of them exist.
Config static_asserts L28-34 (nthreads<=512 and %32, nbatch_fa<=256 and %32, nbatch_K2/V2/combine limits, occupancy<=8, nstages in 1..2) hold for the fixed config and stay host-side.
runtime_caller_requirements_preserved_no: kb0_start<kb0_stop for every process_tile call (native comment L1349: 'kb0_start is always < kb0_stop so the last iter can be executed unconditionally'); the host KV_max scan and stream-K partition must maintain this including the dense clamp kb0_stop=KV_max/32.
mask non-null whenever ncols2>1 and ne33>=1 when the mask is used (L1921-1922 else branch is compiled in).
scan_mask host gate requires K->ne[1]%FATTN_KQ_STRIDE==0 and the KV_max buffer sized ntiles_x*ne03 int32 (fattn-common.cuh L1117-1133).
cp.async 16 B alignment of the shared/global addresses (process-side, per the process contract).
native_guards_and_caller_requirements.builtin_assume: The only __builtin_assume in the supplied translation unit is 'tid < D' in flash_attn_combine_results (fattn-common.cuh L953), which belongs to the separate vec combine kernel and is not part of this port; the MMA outer/process/iter functions contain none. No global architecture guarantee is assumed anywhere.
native_guards_and_caller_requirements.no_global_architecture_guarantee: Config resolution (L234-266) is per-arch at compile time in native; this entry implements exactly the Ampere-row instantiation for (256,256,ncols1*8) and must not be launched on other architectures or configurations.

numerical_contract: The entry performs no floating-point arithmetic; scale is forwarded bit-exact as f32 and slope is the literal 1.0f.

All index/address arithmetic is integer with native widths and operand order: i32 products/divisions where native uses int (including the int32 total product at L1899, wrapping exactly as native), i64 where native promotes via int64_t or int64_t strides, and sign-extending i32->i64 before pointer adds for native i32 pointer offsets.
The dense KV_max read is a raw little-endian int32 load; kb0_stop=min(kb0_stop, kv/32) uses native signed i32 division (scan outputs are non-negative).
fastdiv/fastmodulo are replaced by explicit / and % on the exact same divisors (task-allowed); results are the exact native integer quotients/remainders.

per_thread_pod_storage.contract: The four buffers (task names: qregs 256 B, vregs 256 B, max 8 B, sum 8 B) arrive as raw u64 entry arguments from the parent CUDA wrapper and are forwarded verbatim to process_tile parameters 30-33 (qregs, vkqregs, kmax, rowsums). The entry never reads, writes, initializes or offsets these bytes; initialization, layout and lifetime rules are the process module's (see inputs/process-contract.json per_thread_pod_storage).
per_thread_pod_storage.why_forwarded: Task requires no VM heap and no local-address intrinsic; the native outer kernel also holds no per-thread state beyond indices, so forwarding is the exact native dataflow.

shared_memory.note: Native L2033-2043 for this config: nbytes_shared_combine=64*132*4=33792; nbytes_shared_Q=ncols*132*4 (16896 for ncols1=4, 33792 for ncols1=8); nbytes_shared_KV(2-stage)=32*(128+128)*4=32768; nbytes_shared_mask=ncols1*(32/2+4)*4=ncols1*80 (320/640); Q_in_reg union gives max(combine, max(Q, KV+mask))=33792 for both ncols1 variants. The wrapper provides the base; the entry performs no shared loads/stores/barriers itself.
shared_memory.map_reference: byte map, swizzle and barrier schedule are owned by the process module: see inputs/process-contract.json shared_memory

unresolved_capabilities: as! narrowing is demonstrated in the supplied examples only for u32->i32; it is used here for u32->i32 (KV_max value) and i64->i32 (kbc/kbc_stop truncation mirroring the native int assignments at L1899-1900). Parent codegen must confirm i64->i32 truncating semantics or adapt those two sites.

fg175p_pdl_sync is a newly declared primitive symbol (the vec sibling used module-scoped fg175v_sync; the fg175p family in the process contract had no PDL member); the parent binds the actual ISA name once.

The extern symbol fg175m_process_tile is taken from the process draft's self-description (its header line 1); if the built process artifact registers a different symbol the parent adapts the single extern string in device.goose.
Mixed-width arithmetic is always explicitly cast (i32 sides widened before mixing with i64/u64); no implicit cross-width promotion is assumed beyond identical-width operations.

Unused entry parameters (max_bias, m0, m1, n_head_log2, logit_softcap, ne00, ne10, ne13, ne31, ne32, nb32) are accepted per supplied example precedent (goose-example.goose fattn_vec carries unused native params).
No top-level return statement is used; the native early return is mirrored by a guarded final block (control-flow identical).
deferred_scope: All other DKQ/DV/ncols1/ncols2/nwarps/nbatch instantiations and the per-arch config tables (L38-266); Volta, Turing-only, RDNA3/4, CDNA, MUSA, Blackwell.

use_logit_softcap=true, use_sparse=true (sparse indices path L1828/L1894-1896/L1927/L1931-1932), V_is_K_view=true (MLA 576), ncols2==1 (ALiBi slope branch plus the process-side oob_check path), nstages<=1 synchronous loader variants.

Host work stays outside the entry exactly as native: grid/stream-K policy choice (launch_fattn L1145-1190), KV_max scan launch (L1117-1133), F16 preconversion of K/V (L1031-1093), dst_meta allocation, occupancy query, cudaFuncSetAttribute, PDL launch attributes.
The separate fixup/combine kernels flash_attn_stream_k_fixup_uniform/general and flash_attn_combine_results (fattn-common.cuh L729-978) are not part of this entry.
No compiler or production files were touched; no shell, network or agent tools were used; no GPU execution is claimed. Parent codegen and real GPU tests are mandatory and parent-owned.
